title: Solana programs with a known answer (white-box audit)
description: One sound Anchor program and three with a planted flaw, as source. A bad sample passes only when the auditor reports a critical or high finding whose quote Mynt finds in the named file; the good sample passes only when no verified critical or high finding is reported against it. The bad samples are the mainnet gate's test fixtures; the good one is the coding agents' starter program.

tasks.description: The coding agents' own Anchor starter: a ledger that records entries and moves no value. Nothing in it should block.

tasks.planted: A hard-coded key can rewrite any ledger, and a ledger authority can be handed to an account that never signed.
Closing a ledger pays its lamports to an account the caller names, which never signs.
A vault that moves tokens out of a program-owned token account: a value-moving program.
